comments.body:
Hi, I'm doing my MS thesis in physics at Caltech, I had about 4.5 average during the master. I think the easiest way is to know a prof a ETH that knows a prof, but you can also just send emails where you wanna go (that's how I did it).

We had a few interviews but nothing crazy, the prof was just very enthusiastic about getting someone from ETH and didn't really care abt the grades. He asked for 3 letters of recommendation tho

The hardest part was to find a prof a ETH to co-supervise. Since I'm in plasma physics, I couldn't find anyone at ETH in the field, so I had to convince a prof with a completely different background but it ended up working out.

Good luck!
comments.author: jujumusk
